subject: Pilot preservation request — 12-day warmup while PO clears
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediflow.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: keep pilot active while PO in legal review

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team is excited about what Redwood can do for our discharge-summary automation. We're in the final stages of routing the PO through procurement and legal, but there's an unexpected hold: procurement flagged a vendor appendix that legal wants one more pass on. The procurement lead says this will take ~10 business days to clear.

Our pilot account is set to expire on June 14, which would interrupt the demo for several stakeholders next week. Would Redwood be able to keep the pilot live for an additional 12 days (or provide a short-term token/warmup allowance) while our PO completes review? We can share the PO draft now (attached) and will prioritize getting the final PO and PO number to you as soon as it's signed.

Attachments: MediFlow_PO_draft.pdf (purchase-order draft, redacted cost lines)

If you prefer a shorter bridge (e.g., 7–10 days) instead of 12, let me know — our goal is to keep the demo available for two upcoming clinical-review sessions.

Appreciate any help,
Claire Nguyen
Head of Clinical Ops
MediFlow
claire.nguyen@mediflow.io
+1 (415) 555-0183
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@mediflow.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: keep pilot active while PO in legal review

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the draft. Glad to hear the sessions are moving along.

We can absolutely keep the pilot environment active while the PO is routed. Policy-wise I can approve a 10-calendar-day extension today (no changes to the trial terms) plus a one-time 1,000-token warmup credit to make sure your tracked flows don't hit hard throttles during the clinical reviews. If 12 days is important, I can escalate to Ben for the extra window, but standard practice is 7–10 days for procurement delays.

Two quick asks so we can record this:
- Please reply to confirm you accept the 10-day extension + 1,000-token credit.
- When you have the PO number, drop it into the HubSpot deal or send it to billing@redwood.com so finance can tie the invoice to the credit. 

I'm copying Ben (sales lead) and Kimberly (billing) so they're aware. If Ben wants to approve the longer 12-day option, he'll chime in.

Attachment: extension_terms.txt (short note on extension mechanics)

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
